thread:
kevin-cs: Hey team, high-priority customer (AcmeRetail) just reported duplicated completions and a double billing charge when their web client reconnects during streaming. They see partial output, then after reconnect the model replays and finishes again. Customer angry. Filed support#7891.

mira-sre: Oof. Any logs from their side? Is this the classic 'last chunk acknowledged lost' scenario?

kevin-cs: They shared a network capture and our request IDs. Here are the important bits: initial stream with id `req-41f9`, we emitted 7 chunks and a final `event: done` chunk. Client got up to chunk 5, then network drop. On reconnect they did a fresh `POST /v1/streams` without idempotency and got the whole generation again. Billing shows two completed generations for the same user within 30s.

ana-ml: Do we attach any resume token in the SSE metadata? We added `X-Resume-Token` in the last rollout — but only returned it in `done` responses previously. If client doesn't persist it, they can't resume.

kevin-cs: Right — client didn't get `done`, so they didn't have the resume token. They just re-sent prompt. Repro steps attached by customer (condensed):
1) Start streaming `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"long prompt"}' https://api.redwood/infer/stream`
2) Kill network after a few chunks (CTRL+C)
3) Reconnect with a new POST (no idempotency key)
Expected: resume from last ack or at least server-side dedupe. Actual: full re-run + second charge.

devbot: @kevin-cs support#7891 ticket updated: attached customer pcap + billing IDs.

mira-sre: Two things to consider: preventing duplicate billing and making resume semantics more robust. Quick mitigations: (a) short-term: honor an `Idempotency-Key` header on stream POSTs and dedupe identical requests within a 1 minute window, returning 409 or returning the previous response stream if still available. (b) make the resume token available as soon as we open the stream (i.e., send `resume_token` in first SSE comment line) so clients that lose final `done` can still resume.

kevin-cs: Customer asked for timeline and safe workaround now. They can update client to send `Idempotency-Key` for reconnects but they'd prefer automatic resume.

ana-ml: Implementation notes: if we emit resume token early, we need to ensure tokens are stable and scoped: token = HMAC(customer_id + session_id + generator_epoch). Also maintain a short lived dedupe cache keyed by (customer_id, prompt_hash, idempotency_key) mapping to billing-eligible result id. For streaming we can mark a generation as "in-progress" and hold dedupe state until finalization or TTL expiry.

sophia-eng: Also watch out for partial-output edgecases: if client received chunks 1..5 and reconnects with `Last-Event-ID` or `X-Resume-Token`, server should be able to stream the missing suffix without recomputing from scratch. That requires us to keep KV-cache snapshots for last N tokens or store serialized KV cache for active in-flight generations. That has memory/cost tradeoffs.

mira-sre: Agreed. Short-term action items:
- Add server-side support for honoring `Idempotency-Key` on stream POSTs (mira-sre assigned)
- Update streaming contract to include optional `X-Resume-Token` in the opening comment (ana-ml to spec)
- Add a billing guard: prevent double-charge on identical prompt hash within 60s when idempotency or resume token present (luke-finance to sign off)

luke-finance: I can sign off on guard if we only block billing when customer-provided idempotency or server-provided resume token exists. We can't guess dedupe across arbitrary prompt variations. Need logs to reconcile the two charges for AcmeRetail before issuing refund.

kevin-cs: I've asked AcmeRetail for the exact request header dump and client version. Requested permission to issue a temporary credit while we investigate.

ana-ml: For medium-term roadmap: implement streaming resume using a lightweight append-only event journal per generation id. On reconnect, provide a `resume_offset` and server streams from that offset by replaying journal slices + continuing generation. That avoids recompute and makes dedupe/billing trivial. But storage and retention policy needed.

sophia-eng: Implementation checklist for the idempotency quick fix:
```
// server-side pseudocode
on POST /stream:
  key = req.headers["Idempotency-Key"] or compute_key(req.body)
  if dedupe_cache.get(key) == COMPLETED and within_ttl:
    return stored_final_response (or 409 with stored_id)
  if dedupe_cache.get(key) == IN_PROGRESS:
    attach client to existing in-progress stream if same customer
  else:
    mark IN_PROGRESS, start generation, write resume_token early to SSE comment
```

mira-sre: Also add metrics: `sse.reconnect.count`, `sse.duplicate.billing.count`, `sse.resume.success.count`. Alert when duplicate.billing spikes >1% of streams per minute.

kevin-cs: Customer accepted temporary credit pending final RCA. They want ETA on quick fix (idempotency + early resume token) — can we get an EOD patch?

sophia-eng: I'll try to wire the header emission this afternoon; idempotency hook needs a short design doc but EOD patch for minimum viable dedupe is doable.

mira-sre: I'll add a short-term tracing tag to mark deduped responses so finance can recon the charges.

luke-finance: Once we have tags and logs, I can reconcile and process refund. Keep me in loop.

kevin-cs: Thanks all. I'll update ticket support#7891 with the action plan and patch ETA. If anyone wants to test against Acme dev org, I can provision a sandbox token.

mira-sre: Quick TODOs in thread: 1) PR for Idempotency hook, 2) PR for SSE opening comment resume token, 3) metric + alert, 4) finance reconciliation run. Ping me when PRs land for review. :thumbsup:

devbot: PRs created: 4321 (idempotency), 4322 (sse-token-header), linked to support#7891.

kevin-cs: Closing loop: customer happy with credit + ETA. Will follow up after patch roll.
